chapter_seo_title: Daode Tianzun Ch. 215: Yang Xiao Hai’s View of a Broken Li Huowang
chapter_meta_description: Ch. 215 of the Dao-Twisted World: Through young Yang Xiao Hai’s eyes, the daily grind of survival meets the creeping horror of Li Huowang’s worsening madness.
og_title: A Child Watches the Pillar Crumble — Daode Tianzun Ch. 215
og_description: Yang Xiao Hai tends the fire while Li Huowang, half-skinless, talks to a dead monk he alone can see. The quietest horror of the Dao-Twisted World.
twitter_title: When a kid notices the leader keeps his cart far away, you know the horror is deep.
twitter_description: Ch. 215: Yang Xiao Hai practices swordplay and cooks noodles while Li Huowang decays into a ghoulish, whispering shell. Survival’s new normal.
